paper_title: Photometric-redshift prior consistency and calibration in galaxy-catalogue dark-siren Hubble-constant inference

required_packages.purpose: Integration, special functions, statistics (cosmology tables, HPD levels)
Cramer-Rao bounds CSV and galaxy-catalogue handling

operating_systems: RHEL 9.x (bwUniCluster 3.0 login node, paper build only)
system_requirements.gpu: None required for paper artifacts (CUDA 12 is only needed for the upstream EMRI simulation pipeline)

input_data.name: GLADE+ reduced galaxy catalogue (z_helio variant, 8-column)
input_data.download_url: http://glade.elte.hu/ (upstream GLADE+; reduced extract produced by master_thesis_code/galaxy_catalogue)
input_data.license: GLADE+ is publicly available for scientific use (Dalya et al. 2022)
input_data.transformations: 8-column reduced GLADE+ extract with heliocentric redshifts; the variant used by all committed seed600 baselines

input_data.name: seed600 prepared Cramer-Rao bounds (EMRI campaign, 3375 events)
input_data.transformations: Per-event Fisher/Cramer-Rao table; the 494-event GLADE+ subsample used by the de-rail matrix is drawn from it

input_data.name: De-rail matrix results (real seed600 GLADE+ subsample, 5 normalization modes)
input_data.transformations: Per-mode combined posteriors also under results/commission_20260701/redteam/posteriors_per_mode/<mode>/ (read by fig_derail_matrix.py)

generated_data.name: fig_pp_coverage_data.json (P-P values + coverage summary, bare vs volume kernel)

external_dependencies.resource: TeX Live (>= 2020) with the vendored mnras.cls/mnras.bst for the PDF build
external_dependencies.access_method: bwUniCluster 3.0 login node (or any TeX Live install); see paper_a/Makefile header
external_dependencies.restrictions: bwHPC account required for the cluster route; none for a local TeX Live

execution_steps.name: fig-pp-coverage
execution_steps.expected_wall_time: ~30-60 min (single core; 250 realizations x 3 truths x 2 kernels)

execution_steps.name: build-pdf
execution_steps.command: make -C paper_a  # requires TeX Live; on the dev box: rsync to bwunicluster:paper_a_build/ and make there (see paper_a/Makefile header)

expected_results.quantity: MAP h, 4pi-only completion fix (prod_global, sign-flipped rail)
MAP h, local_ratio and volume_deconv prior-consistent estimators
expected_results.tolerance: exact grid node; local_ratio interior mass 0.98, volume_deconv mean +0.010 above local_ratio

expected_results.quantity: 90 per cent HPD coverage, volume-deconvolved kernel, h_true = 0.72
90 per cent HPD coverage, bare-Gaussian kernel, h_true = 0.72
expected_results.tolerance: +/- 0.05 (binomial, 250 realizations; near-zero coverage is the qualitative claim)

output_files.description: P-P / coverage plot, bare vs volume kernel (fig:pp)
Compiled 21-page MNRAS manuscript (0 LaTeX errors, 0 undefined references)

minimum_viable: 1 core, 4 GB RAM, ~1 h for all figures; any TeX Live >= 2020 for the PDF
recommended: 4 cores, 8 GB RAM; figures other than fig-pp-coverage are instant

random_seeds.purpose: Base seed for the synthetic-universe P-P harness; per-realization child seeds are derived deterministically and shared between the bare and volume kernels so the comparison is exactly paired

seeding_strategy: The only stochastic paper step (fig-pp-coverage) fixes base seed 20260701 in the figure script; per-realization child seeds are derived deterministically and reused across kernels. Upstream simulation data (seed600 CRB) was produced with the repository's --seed CLI convention (BASE_SEED + SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID), recorded per run in run_metadata.json.

known_platform_differences.issue: Matplotlib embeds creation timestamps in PDF metadata, so regenerated figure files are not byte-identical to the recorded checksums.
known_platform_differences.workaround: Set SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH for byte-stable output, or compare figure content numerically via expected_results and fig_pp_coverage_data.json.

known_platform_differences.issue: main.pdf bytes depend on the TeX Live version (build tested on the bwUniCluster login node, TeX Live 2020).
known_platform_differences.workaround: Check for 0 LaTeX errors / 0 undefined references and 21 pages instead of byte identity.

verification_steps: Rerun the four figure scripts from the repository root with .venv/bin/python and confirm each exits 0 and regenerates its PDF.
Compare the regenerated paper_a/figures/data/fig_pp_coverage_data.json coverage table against the expected_results tolerances (volume kernel near-nominal, bare kernel near-zero coverage).
Confirm the MAP values read at run time from derail_matrix_results.json and G3_ablation_cube.json match the values quoted in the manuscript sections (0.86 / 0.60 / 0.73 / 0.73).
Rebuild paper_a/main.pdf via make -C paper_a and check 0 LaTeX errors and 0 undefined references at 21 pages.
last_verified_platform: Arch Linux x86_64, Python 3.13.12, uv-managed .venv (figure inputs + checksums verified; PDF build verified on bwUniCluster login node TeX Live)
